name: splitbrief
description: The SPLITBRIEF pipeline as agent skills: this session plans and compiles Product Task Briefs, a cheaper coding tool builds them, the project's own gates and a drift check judge every attempt, a bounded retry ladder escalates, and an evidence-bound review closes the run

plugins.name: splitbrief
plugins.description: Four skills, one pipeline. splitbrief: brief → run → review in one invocation, with impl=<tool>[:<model>][@<effort>] and review=<…> seats spawned headless. splitbrief-brief: compile briefs only. splitbrief-run: execute existing briefs with gates, drift and the retry ladder. splitbrief-review: evidence-bound review of a foreign build. Prompt blocks and tool argv are generated from the SPLITBRIEF CLI itself
